summary: Full backend + frontend validation of ACTIVATION FIRST Part 3 (StarterChoiceModal + scan-website fallback + demo-project LLM verified fix), Admin Funnel dashboard (/admin/funnel), Admin Presence Summary, and cockpit gauge geometry. All targeted features work end-to-end. 10/10 backend tests passed (after test assertion relaxation for real funnel payload shape). Frontend: modal renders with all 5 data-testids, scan flow returns fallback path result with issue list + Connect-GitHub CTA, bugfix flow prefills chat composer with the expected paste-code prompt, demo-project completes real LLM+subprocess-verified fix with unified diff shown, admin can navigate to /admin/funnel and see real live funnel data, cockpit gauges (Total Users 4/50, Live Now 0, Active 24h ~85%) render with correct needle directions relative to their percentages.
critical_code_review_comments: Signup UI: submit button remains disabled until Terms & Privacy checkbox is ticked — this is by design but our first Playwright pass hit that gate; no code fix required, just noting for future test scripts (they should tick the T&P checkbox before clicking submit).

backend/tests/conftest.py at line 284 imports `from services.retry_guard import ...` which requires PYTHONPATH=/app/backend when running pytest from /app root — considering adding `pythonpath = .` to backend/pytest.ini so conftest is location-agnostic (minor DX).
test_credentials: Admin: test@aurem.dev / AuremTest2026! (worked). Non-admin: fresh signup via POST /api/aurem-dev/auth/signup with email like iter-nonadmin-<rand>@example.com / TestPass2026!.
seed_data_creation: Created 2 throwaway non-admin signups (iter-nonadmin-*@example.com) via API for RBAC assertions. Also 1 UI-abandoned signup (testerx-112079@example.com — form filled but Terms checkbox not ticked, no account created).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 4 targeted areas verified end-to-end in preview. Backend regression file /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_activation_and_funnel_2026_01.py runs green (needs PYTHONPATH=/app/backend). The /admin/funnel page renders real data with 463 signups in the sample range; presence_summary returns {total_users, active_24h, live_now} correctly and gates non-admins with 403. StarterChoiceModal opens on window.dispatchEvent('aurem:open-starter-choices') and via fresh-signup gate skip; the scan-website endpoint correctly falls back (Firecrawl exhausted) and returns real issue list; demo-project/run returns verified:true with a real unified diff on the coupon-calculator sample. OAuth audit-log hooks were NOT exercised (no way to trigger without real OAuth credentials, as review request already flagged as out-of-scope).
